cases.customer_question: Will an Option 2b Bluetooth SIG registration create additional testing requirements, costs, or schedule delays for the selected qualification design?
question_variants: Will the selected QDIDs trigger a Test Plan?
Can Option 2b be completed without additional qualification testing?
Is there risk of extra cost from the chosen registration path?
How can I verify that a registration design will not generate new tests?
cases.actual_issue: Assessing whether a planned Option 2b registration path introduces additional qualification test obligations when reusing existing qualified Bluetooth designs.
cases.plain_english_explanation: Not every Bluetooth SIG registration path requires new testing. When a product is built from previously qualified Bluetooth building blocks, the registration system may allow reuse without creating new test obligations. The registration design must still be checked before proceeding.
cases.consultant_answer: The consultant performed a preliminary project review using the proposed qualification references and confirmed that the selected Option 2b registration path did not generate any additional Test Plan requirements. Based on that validation, no additional testing, added qualification cost, or schedule impact was expected from the qualification design itself.
cases.decision_logic: The registration design should be validated against the Bluetooth SIG qualification system before execution. If the selected qualified building blocks do not generate additional Test Plan obligations, the registration can proceed without new testing requirements.
cases.final_recommendation: Create a preliminary qualification project and verify Test Plan generation before committing to the registration approach. Proceed with the design only after confirming that no additional qualification tests are required.
cases.risk_if_done_wrong: Failing to verify the qualification design in advance can lead to unexpected testing obligations, qualification rework, additional cost exposure, and project delays.
